system.description: The vampire must first perceive the target object (a Static Mental Test may be required for difficult observations, or enhanced senses like Heightened Senses for extremely fast-moving objects), then spend two Blood Traits and succeed at a Static Physical Challenge (retest with Occult). Each Trait risked extends the freeze's duration. All mechanical, electrical, and chemical processes in the object (including kinetic energy) halt until the duration expires, then resume as if no time passed. May not be used on anything larger than the vampire or more complex than a dog.
